result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d increase our collective capacity for empathy — not just feeling for others, but genuinely trying to understand perspectives unlike our own.

So many of the world’s hardest problems — conflict, inequality, environmental harm — are made harder because people struggle to fully grasp how their choices affect others. If empathy were deeper and more widespread, I think cooperation, kindness, and long-term thinking would become much easier.
